Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.gitgui

Class GitCommands

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.gitgui.GitCommands
public final class GitCommands extends Object
Pure git command-line builders for the Git GUI.

Every method here returns an argument list and starts no process, so the exact command lines the app drives are unit-testable headless - the same separation the Security Center's AntivirusBackend uses. The thin, guarded launch lives in GitRepository.

The desktop ships no JGit and no libgit2 binding: like the recorder handing screen capture to ffmpeg and the VPN client handing the tunnel to nmcli, this app honestly delegates every operation to the system git on PATH. Two global switches are prepended to read commands so their output is machine-parseable regardless of the user's config:

  • -c core.quotePath=false - keep non-ASCII paths literal instead of octal-escaping them, so GitParsers sees the real filename;
  • -c color.ui=false / --no-optional-locks - never emit ANSI colour and never take a lock that a concurrent git could contend.
